note: Vietnamese TRANSLATIONS of the semantic-suite queries, not recovered user queries. The machine-wide transcript archive holds only 2 real Vietnamese store queries (see docs/evals/multilingual.md), so cross-lingual retrieval is measured on faithful translations, labelled as such and reported separately from the English control. Fixtures stay English on purpose: the stored corpus is ~100% English, so Vietnamese-query-over-English-atoms is the real scenario. Two registers per case: viMixed is how a Vietnamese developer actually types (established loanwords like cache/token/request kept), viPure maximally translates everything but proper nouns (redis, git, json, hmac) - the stress case matching the register of the 2 real queries. Off-topic probes are the 10 junk queries floor-sweep.md calibrated the relevance floor with, translated once (they are everyday topics; one register suffices).
